LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_FluidAccelerator.label: (Raven) Fluid Accelerator
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_FluidAccelerator.descriptio: A special gland-regulating implant installed inside the body. Originally an intimate Raven technology, it can rapidly increase the volume of special bodily fluids and eject them under high pressure when needed. The bearer will involuntarily spray semen or love juices depending on their sex. Due to its enormous output and unique physical properties, it can even serve as a walking fire extinguisher.\n\nTriggers automatically when exposed to fire, or can be activated manually.
